title: Need or want?
prompt: Sort each thing: is it a need or a want?

items.text: Rice and dal for the week
items.explanation: Food you need to stay healthy is a need.
Getting to school is a need. A cheaper way there could still meet it.
Health comes first, so medicine is a need.
Bills that keep the home running are needs. Skipping them causes bigger problems later.
You need them for school. Fancy covers would be the want part.
Fun is fine to plan for, but it's a want. You can choose when to spend on it.

items.text: A new phone cover when the old one works
items.explanation: The old one still does the job, so a new one is a want.

items.text: A skin in an online game
items.explanation: It looks nice but you don't need it. Small in-game buys add up quickly.

items.text: Brand-name shoes when yours still fit
items.explanation: Shoes are a need, but new branded ones while yours fit are a want.

items.text: Street food every day after school
items.explanation: A treat now and then is fine. Every day, it's a want that eats your savings.
